cases.title: You're Wearing the Orange Vest
cases.presentation: The IC hands you the TRANSPORT vest at a 26-patient bus crash. Three hospitals: General (Level I trauma, 8 min), St. Mary's (community, 5 min), Children's (12 min). 4 red, 8 yellow, 14 green — including 3 injured children.
cases.question: Best distribution strategy?
options: A: Let each ambulance crew decide.

B: Reds to General (trauma center) a few at a time, yellows split between General and St. Mary's, injured children toward Children's per capability, greens by bus with a medic to a less-busy hospital — all logged.
C: Hold everyone until you hear from all hospitals.
D: Everyone to St. Mary's — it's closest.
cases.explanation: Match severity to capability and spread the load. Nearby hospitals already get flooded by self-presenters. Log every departure.

cases.title: The Triage Officer Who Stayed
cases.presentation: Fifteen minutes into an apartment-fire MCI, the triage count hasn't been updated since the first report. The triage officer is found inserting an IO in a burned toddler.
cases.question: What's the problem and fix?
options: B: Nothing — the toddler is critical.
C: Triage has stopped: hand the toddler to the treatment area team, return the triage officer to sorting and reporting counts.
D: Make the triage officer the transport officer.
cases.explanation: When the triage officer treats, triage halts and untagged reds go unfound. Lifesaving interventions in triage are seconds-long only.
cases.clinicalPearl: Triage touches for seconds, then moves.

cases.title: Staging Chaos
cases.presentation: Mutual-aid ambulances keep driving straight to the scene, blocking the fire apparatus and the loading zone. Two crews have loaded green patients on their own and left.
cases.question: Best fix?
options: A: Close the road to all ambulances.
B: Let them continue — more transports is good.
C: Ask dispatch to cancel mutual aid.
D: Appoint a Staging Officer, set a staging location in the METHANE update, require check-in, and release units only on Transport Officer request.
cases.explanation: Staging restores flow and accountability. Self-dispatching units clog access and lose patient tracking.
cases.clinicalPearl: Check in, keys in, crews in.
